items.label: Profile
items.content: R&D Prototyping Engineer specializing in bridging the gap between cutting-edge spatial computing, generative AI tools, and real-time 3D production. Thrives in ambiguous environments, rapidly transforming technical concepts into functional, high-fidelity tools and demonstrations for creative teams. Has a passion for blending technology, storytelling, and the arts.

jobs.title: Fractional Technical Program Head
bullets: Built ELIXR's entire XR development and rapid-prototyping stack from scratch: reusable project templates and tooling, build pipelines, testing and evaluation workflows, documentation, SOPs, and hiring systems.
Lead end-to-end discovery and prototyping for institutional clients, turning ambiguous requirements into working demonstrations on tight timelines.
Continuously evaluate emerging XR, computer-vision, and AI tools, building targeted prototypes to validate feasibility, performance, and usability before production commitment.
Mentor XR developers and program fellows, and set the standards the rest of the team prototypes against.

**City of Calgary, WAVE Technology Centre:** delivered four proof-of-concept XR prototypes (VR training, mixed-reality, smart-glasses reporting, 360 video) from scoping through stakeholder evaluation.
**Red Deer Polytechnic & Alberta Sports Hall of Fame:** led the team integrating OpenCV computer-vision tracking with a real-time Unity simulation for a permanent wheelchair-curling installation.
**Northern Alberta Institute of Technology:** built an AI-enabled VR nursing simulator (SBAR communication protocol) with a real-time AI loop grading communication proficiency.
**Edmonton Chinatown Heritage Association:** built a phone-based AR app where users scan historic murals to reveal 3D animations and unlock local-business rewards.

header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: R&D Prototyping Engineer · Real-Time 3D · XR/VR/AR · Product Development

body: I've been building crazy, technical tools for storytelling and entertainment since I was a kid. My earliest memories are of using MS Paint to design computerized cardboard mech suits for our neighborhood water fights, and building HTML sites for my sister's imaginary friend.

Since then I've toured the world as a jazz drummer, taken VR startups from concept to successful raises, and built an XR prototyping team that worked with institutions like the City of Calgary, the Northern Alberta Institute of Technology, and the Telus World of Science.

I'm applying for the R&D Engineer role because it truly aligns with the work I've set out to do in this life, and because I feel that I can bring real value to it. I know how to rapidly build and test prototypes, know how to ship things from concept to handoff, and know how to dig into a user's needs to find out what we actually need to build.

With Adventure Portal I designed a multiplayer, free-roam VR experience that turns real NASA archive content into a massive, explorable cinematic world. It has since been picked up by a major VR publisher for distribution across a network of 400+ locations.
For the City of Calgary I led a team delivering four different prototypes across AR and VR, helping the city learn how to think about XR and what it takes to build in it.
For ELIXR I led the build of an entire internal development program, guiding teams of students to build XR prototypes for major institutions.

I work flexibly across tech stacks, and I have as much experience leading complex projects as building the tools myself. Bridging the gap between bleeding-edge technology and exciting storytelling is what I've done my whole life, and it's the work I want to keep doing. I would love to bring my prototyping skills and my experience with XR, 3D storytelling, and AI to your team.
